items.alt: Historic storefronts on Main Street in downtown Logan
items.title: The heart of Logan.
items.caption: Every Christmas our family walks Main Street to see the lights. Local shops and a busy downtown keep that heart beating.

items.alt: Logan Canyon at sunset with the highway winding along the river
items.title: Minutes from the mountains.
items.caption: Imagine walking or biking from your neighborhood all the way up the canyon. That's the "Logan Greenway."

items.alt: Old Main at Utah State University under a dramatic sky
items.title: Where our Logan story started.
items.caption: My wife and I came here for USU and never left. I want today's graduates to be able to afford to stay too.
